verdict.rationale: Orama is a search and RAG platform, and a buyer could fairly ask whether it can schedule recurring jobs such as periodic data-source syncs, so the axis applies. The pack never documents a scheduler, cron, or recurring workflow feature. The mention of data that "follows a different update schedule" describes how users organise data sources, not a product scheduling capability, and the JavaScript runtime for agents is only a building block.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
